description.value: Red Barn Winery is a boutique winery situated on Black Sage Road in Oliver, squarely in the heart of South Okanagan wine country and along one of BC's most popular cycling corridors. Wines are sourced from Jagged Rock Vineyard and lean into bold fruit expression under an intentionally rebellious brand identity. The property hosts seasonal events including Tramonto Music Nights with live music on the patio, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the region.
